ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) An employee's annual salary was increased Tk. 25,000. If her new annual salary now equals Tk. 90,000, what was the percent increase?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
New annual salary = Tk. 90,000
Salary increase = Tk. 25,000.

Original salary
= Tk. (90,000 - 25,000).
= 65,000

Percentage Increase
= (25,000/ 65,000) × 100%
= 38.46%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) Successive discount of 30% and 35% are equal to a single discount of -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the original price be Tk. 100
After 30% discount the price is Tk. (100 - 30) = Tk. 70
Again, after 15% discount new price is Tk. (70 - 70 ×35/100) = 70 - 24.5 = 45.5
Total discount = (100 - 45.5) = 54.5%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) What is the rate of discount is a car that had a regular price of Tk. 30,00,000 is sold for Tk. 27,90,000?
৪) A sum of money amounts to Tk. 920 in 3 years and to Tk. 1000 in five years. Find the rate percent per amount -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
After 5 years the sum = Tk. 1000
After 3 years the sum = Tk. 920
The interest of 2 years = Tk. (1000 - 920) = Tk. 80
The interest of 3 years, I = Tk. 80 x (3/2) = Tk. 120
The principle, P = Tk. (920 - 120) = Tk. 800
So, the rate = I/Pn = 120/(800 x 3) × 100% = 5%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) Income tax is raised-from 4% to 5% but the revenue is increased by 10% only. Find the decreased percentage in the amount taxed.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the original taxed amount be Tk. x and
new taxed amount be Tk. y
Let the original revenue be Tk. 100
Then, 4% of Tk. x = 100
or, x = (100 × 100)/4 = Tk. 2500
New revenue = 110% of Tk. 100 = Tk. 110
Then, 5% of Tk. y = 110
or, y = (110×100)/5 = Tk. 2200
Decrease in taxed amount = Tk. (2500 - 2200) = Tk. 300
∴ Decrease % = (300/2500) ×100 = 12%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) The present worth of Tk. 10816 due to in 2 years at 4% per annum compound interest is
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
A = P(1 + r)n
⇒ 10816 = P(1 + 4/100)2
Therefore, present worth,
P = 10816/(1 + 4/100)2
    = 10816/(1.04)2
    = 10816/1.0816
    = Tk. 10,000

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) A man's salary was reduced by 30%, again the reduce salary was increased by 30%. Find the loss of in term of percentage.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the salary was Tk. 100

A man's salary was reduced by 30%.
So, salary will be Tk. (100 - 30) = Tk. 70

Again the reduce salary was increased by 30%.
So, salary will be Tk. (70 + 30% of 70) = Tk. (70 + 21) = Tk. 91

Loss of in term of percentage = Tk. (100 - 91) = Tk. 9

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) A product is sold at a profit of 20%. If the cost price is increased by 10% and sale price by Tk. 26, then the percentage of profit reduce by 5%, cost price is
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let, the cost price be Tk. x
Selling price at 20% profit
= x + 20% of x
= x + 20x/100
= 120x/100
= Tk. 6x/5

The cost price is increased by 10%. 
So, new cost price
= (x + 10% of x)
= Tk. 11x/10

Therefore, new selling price = Tk. (6x/5 + 26)

New profit = (6x/5 + 26) - 11x/6
                   = Tk. (x/10 + 26)

According to the question,
(x/10 + 26) ÷ 11x/10 × 100 = 15
⇒ (x + 260) × 100/11x = 15
⇒ 65x = 26,000
∴ x = 400

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) A salesman sells two shirts at BDT 594 each. On one he gains 10% and on the other, he loses 10%. Find his gain or loss percent on the whole.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
At 10% profit, The cost price of the first shirt
= 100/(100 + 10) × 594
= Tk. 540

At 10% loss, The cost price of the second shirt
= 100/(100 - 10) × 594
= Tk. 660

Now, the total cost price of two shirts
= 540 + 660
= Tk. 1200

and the total sell price of two shirts
= 594 × 2
= Tk. 1188

Loss = 1200 - 1188
        = Tk. 12 

Percentage of loss = (12/1200 × 100)%
                               = 1%
--------------------------------------------------------
Shortcut: 
Loss percentage = (common gain or loss/10)% = (10/10)% = 1%
[ When a salesman sells two shirts at same price each and on one there is gain is equal to on other there is loss in percentage, then there shall be always loss percent on the whole and loss percentage will be (common gain or loss/10)% ]

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) 60% of 200 is what percent of 160?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 60% of 200 be x percent of 160.
that means, 60% of 200 = x% of 160.
⇒ 60 × 200/100 = 160x/100
⇒ 120 = 8x/5
⇒ 8x = 600
⇒ x = 75

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) P sells a product to Q and makes a profit of 25%. Q sells in to R at a loss of 20%. If R buys it for Tk. 140, what price did P pay for it?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the cost price of P be Tk. x
selling price of P = (x + 25% of x) = Tk. 5x/4
So, cost price of Q = Tk. 5x/4
selling price of Q = 80% of Tk. 5x/4 = Tk. x
So, cost price of R = Tk. x = Tk. 140
Therefore, the cost price of P is Tk. x = Tk. 140

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) Kowshik earns taka 11 for each ticket that he sells and a bonus of taka 2 per ticket for each ticket he sells over 100. If Kowshik was paid taka 3700, how many tickets did he sell?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Suppose, Kowshik sells x ticket
price of all ticket without bonus = Tk. 11x
Number of bonus ticket = (x - 100)
Therefore, 11x + 2(x - 100) = 3700
⇒ 11x + 2x - 200 = 3700
⇒ 13x = 3900
⇒ x = 300

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) There is an 80% increase in an amount in 8 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk. 14,000 after 3 years at the same rate?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
80% increase in 8 years at simple interest. That is 10% each year.
Therefore,
Rate of interest is 10%
10% (14000) = 1400
10% (1400) = 140
10% (140) = 14
Required compound interest = 3(1400 + 140) + 14
= Tk. 4634.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) There is 12% salt in 300 mm mixture. If 200 mm water is added to it, then what percentage of salt is there in the new mixture?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
In 300 mm mixture, amount of salt = 12% of 300 = 36 mm
If 200 mm water is added to it, total mixture = 200 + 300 = 500 mm
Therefore, amount of salt percentage = 36/500 × 100% = 7.2%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) A shopkeeper sells a pen-drive by 5% discount. In 8% discount, he earns Tk.15. What is the marked price of the pen-drive?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Suppose, marked price of the pen-drive is Tk. x
At 5% discount, selling price of pen-drive = (100 - 5)x = Tk. 95x
At 8% discount, selling price of pen-drive = (100 - 8)x = Tk. 92x
Therefore,
95% of x - 92% of x = 15
⇒ 95x/100 - 92x/100 = 15
⇒ 3x = 1500
⇒ x = 500

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) The price of a flower is 25% more than the price of a book. The price of a flower-vase is 75% more than the price of the book. How much is the price of the flower-vase more than the price of the flower?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the price of book
= Tk. 100

Price of flower
= Tk. (100 + 100 × 25%)
= Tk. 125

Price of flower-vase
= Tk. (100 + 100 × 75%)
= Tk. 175

Difference of flower-vase and flower's price
= Tk. (175 -125)
= Tk. 50

∴ Price of the flower-vase more than the price of the flower (in percentage)
= {(50×100)/125}%
= 40%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) As the price of mango has reduced 20%, it is now possible to buy 2 more mangoes at Tk. 12. What is the correct price of 50 mangoes?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
As the price of mango has reduced 20% that means 
mango of Tk. 100 will be available for Tk. 80
Therefore, mango of Tk. 12 will be available for Tk. (80 × 12/100) or Tk. 9.6
So, cost price of 2 mangoes = (12 - 9.6) = Tk. 2.4
cost price of 50 mangoes = Tk. 2.4 × 50/2 = Tk. 60
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
short-cut
20% of Tk. 12 = Tk. 2.4
The price of 2 mangoes is Tk. 2.4
The price of 50 mangoes is Tk. 2.4 × 50/2 = Tk. 60

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) If the salary of an employee is reduced by 10 percent for his late attendance and then increased by 10 percent on a pardon, how much does he lose?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
At 10% decrease,
salary = 100 - 10 = 90

And a 10% increase,
the salary = 90 + 90×10/100 = 99

∴ He is at = 100 - 99 = 1% loss

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) A shopkeeper sold a product at loss of 10%. He had sold it for Tk. 108 more, he would have earned a profit of 10%. Find the cost of the product.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
At loss of 10%, if cost price is Tk. 100, selling price is Tk. (100 - 10) = Tk. 90
At profit of 10%, if cost price is Tk. 100, selling price is Tk. (100 + 10) = Tk. 110
More selling price = Tk. (110 - 90) = Tk. 20
if more selling price is Tk. 20, the cost price is Tk. 100
if more selling price is Tk. 108, the cost price is Tk. 100 × 108/20 = Tk. 540
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Shortcut way:
more selling price = 10 - ( - 10) = 20 
Therefore, 20% of cost price = More selling price
20% of cost price = 108
cost price = Tk. 100 × 108/20 = Tk. 540

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) What will be the compound interest at 10% on a sum of TK. 5000 after 5 years?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Compound interest = Amount − Principal
Amount = 5000(1 + 10/100)5 = 8052.55
So, compound interest = Tk. (8052.55 - 5000) = Tk. 3052.55 ≈ Tk. 3052

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) What will be the difference between simple and compound interest at 10% on a sum of Tk. 1000 after 4 years?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Simple interest = (10 × 4 × 1000)/100 = Tk. 400
Compound amount, c = p(1 + r)n
= 1000{1 + (10/100)}4
= 1000(11/10)4
= 1464.10

∴ Compound interest
= 1464.10 - 1000
= 464.10

∴ Difference between Simple and Compound interest = 464.10 - 400 = Tk. 64.10 ≈ Tk. 64 
------------------------------------------------------------------
10% সুদে, 1,000 টাকার 4 বছরের সুদ = (10 × 4 × 1000)/100
= 400 টাকা।
আমরা জানি,
চক্রবৃদ্ধি মুনাফায় সবৃদ্ধিমূল, c = p(1 + r)n
= 1000{1 + (10/100)}4
= 1000(11/10)4
= 1464.10 টাকা

∴ চক্রবৃদ্ধি মুনাফা
= 1464.10 - 1000
= 464.10 টাকা

∴ সরল এবং চক্রবৃদ্ধি মুনাফার মধ্যে পার্থক্য = 464.10 - 400 = 64.10 টাকা

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) If the ratio of principal and yearly amount be in the ratio 25 : 28, then the yearly rate of interest is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Given, principal : yearly amount = 25 : 28
So, interest = 28 - 25 = 3

So, rate of interest
= 3/25 × 100 %
= 12%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) In what time will ৳ 3300 becomes ৳ 3399 at 6% per annum interest compounded half-yearly?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Principal, P = ৳ 3300
principal with interest, A = ৳ 3399
r = 6% per annum

Let the time be n years.
Compound interest is taken half - yearly.
A = P × [1 + (r/2)]2n
⇒ 3399 = 3300(1 + (3/100))2n [ r/2 = 6%/2 = 3% = 3/100 ]
⇒ (1.03)2n = 3399/3300
⇒ (1.03)2n = (1.03)1
⇒ 2n = 1 year
⇒ n = 1/2 year = 6 months

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) A, B, C investment in a partnership in the ratio of 5 : 6 : 8. The ratio of the profit is 5 : 3 : 12. Find the ratio of time for their investment.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The required ratio of time = ratio of (interest/investment)
= (5/5) : (3/6) : (12/8)
= 1 : 1/2 : 3/2 = 2 : 1 : 3

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) A and B started a business by investing Tk. 4000 and Tk. 5000 respectively. Find the A's share out of a total profit of Tk. 1800.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Ratio of A and B's investment = 4000 : 5000 = 4 : 5
A's share = 4/(4 + 5) × 1800 = Tk. 800

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) By selling a book for Tk. 675, a seller loses 2/9 of his outlay, by selling it for Tk. 810, his gain or loss percentage is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
A seller loses 2/9 of his outlay,
that means if selling price is Tk. 7, then cost price will be (7 + 2) = Tk. 9
if selling price is Tk. 675, then cost price will be Tk. 9 × 675/7 = Tk. 867.86
Loss = Tk. (867.86 - 810) = Tk. 57.86
percentage loss = Tk. 57.86/Tk. 867.86 × 100% = 6.67%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) P and Q start a hotel. P left after 6 months. After the year ends, P gets Tk. 6000 as profit out of total profit of Tk. 9000. What will be amount invested by Q if P had invested Tk. 20,000?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
After the year ends, P gets Tk. 6000 as profit.
So, Q gets (9000 - 6000) = Tk. 3000
Ratio of P and Q's interest = 6000 : 3000 = 2 : 1
If Q invests Tk. x 
So, we get
20,000/2x = 2/1
x = Tk. 5000

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৮) A shopkeeper marks his goods 20% above cost price, but allows 30% discount for cash payment. His net loss is?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the cost price of goods = Tk. 100
Market price of goods = 120% of 100  
                                     = 120/100×100
                                     = Tk. 120
At 30% discount for cash payment, real price = (100 - 30)% = 70%
After discount selling price of goods
= 70% of 120
= Tk. 84
Loss = Tk. (100 − 84) = Tk. 16
Loss % = (16/100) × 100 = 16%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) A student scores 55% marks in 8 papers of 100 marks each. He scores 15% of his total marks in English. How much does he score in English?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total marks obtained by the student = 55% of 800
= {(55/100) × 800}
= 440
 ∴ Marks scored in English
= 15% of 440
= {(15/100) × 440}
= 66

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) If 5% is gained by selling an article for Tk. 350 than selling it for Tk.340, the cost of the article is :
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Selling price difference = (350 – 340) = Tk. 10
So, 5% of an article = Tk. 10
∴ 100% of an article = (10×100)/5 = Tk. 200
